newsitem.title: THAILAND: CMIC says New Straits Times to buy into firm.
newsitem.headline: CMIC says New Straits Times to buy into firm.

text.p: Thailand's CMIC Finance and Securities Plc said it has recived an offer from Malaysia's New Straits Times Press (Malaysia) Bhd to buy more than a 51 percent stake in the company.

CMIC will ask the Bank of Thailand to relax foreign ownership laws of finance firms to let the deal go through, CMIC's Managing Director Pongsathorn Kunanusorn told reporters at the central bank on Friday.
CMIC is one of 16 ailing finance and securities firms which must submit merger plans or announce a foreign buyer by this evening or face compulsory absorption with larger firms.
